item.title: Quarterly and Annual 1:1s unable to load [resolved]
Signups Currently Unavailable [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved. Users are able to sign up for trial accounts.

item.title: Microsoft To-Do Integration: Service Degraded [resolved]
item.description:
This incident has been resolved. Microsoft has deployed a fix for the underlying issue (Microsoft issue ID: MO1331639), and sync operations from Microsoft To-Dos into Ninety are now functioning normally. Two-way sync has been fully restored.
Thank you for your patience while Microsoft worked through the issue on their end.

item.title: Accountability Chart - Some companies experiencing errors [resolved]
item.description: The issue with service is now fully functional. Thank you for your patience.

item.title: Zapier Integration - Some users experiencing rate limiting [resolved]
item.description: We have resolved the issue with Zapier, if you have errored runs in your Zap history attempt to replay those Zaps.
